description.value: Bad Dog Brewing Company is a craft micro-brewery tucked into the rural back roads of Sooke, BC, pouring 12 taps of house-brewed ales, IPAs, stouts, and seasonal specialties in an indoor tasting room, on a heated patio, or at outdoor picnic tables. An on-site Hot Diggity Dog food trailer rounds out the experience with hot food. Now celebrating its 8th year, the brewery hosts live music events and community fundraisers, making it a lively destination on the quieter roads west of Victoria.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms an active craft brewery at 7861 Tugwell Road, Sooke — matching OSM address and URL exactly. The About page confirms the address, product offerings (pints, sleeves, cans, growler fills, tasting flights), indoor tasting room, heated patio, and picnic area; May 2026 posts confirm the business is currently open. No bike parking, washroom, water refill, Wi-Fi, or charging amenities are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so those fields are null per evidence rules.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An active, well-established craft brewery with food service on a rural Sooke cycling route — a compelling and practical stop for touring cyclists heading west of Victoria.
